_readme: Deterministic matching ONLY reads this file. Never let an LLM generate or edit scheme entries. Covers Central schemes across all 28 states of India plus State Government schemes.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Crop Insurance
schemes.category: Crop insurance / pest & disease damage compensation

conditions.notes: Farmer must have enrolled for PMFBY for the relevant season (Kharif/Rabi) BEFORE the loss occurred, in a notified crop/area, to claim compensation. If not already enrolled, the farmer is not eligible for a claim on a loss that already happened, but should enroll before the next season.

schemes.application_process: Enroll before the season's cut-off date via bank branch, Common Service Centre (CSC), authorized insurance channel partner, or the national Crop Insurance app/portal. To claim after a loss, report within 72 hours of the damaging event through the portal, app, or insurance company/bank.

schemes.scheme_name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)

conditions.notes: Income support scheme, not tied to a specific crop-loss event. Eligible landholding farmer families receive fixed installments per year, subject to standard exclusion criteria (e.g. certain institutional landholders, income-tax payers) set by the scheme guidelines.

schemes.application_process: Register via the PM-KISAN portal, Common Service Centre (CSC), or local revenue/agriculture office (patwari/talathi/agriculture assistant) for eKYC and land record verification.

schemes.scheme_name: MahaDBT Farmer Schemes Portal (multiple Maharashtra state schemes)
schemes.category: Multiple: input subsidy, mechanization, irrigation support, etc. (varies by sub-scheme)

conditions.notes: MahaDBT is an umbrella portal listing multiple Maharashtra Department of Agriculture schemes (subsidies for seeds/equipment/irrigation etc). Specific eligibility varies by sub-scheme and is set each season on the portal — the farmer should check current open schemes for their district and crop.

schemes.application_process: Register and apply directly on the MahaDBT Farmer portal; specific sub-schemes open/close on a rolling basis through the season.

schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra Department of Agriculture - General Farmer Support & Advisory

conditions.notes: Not a single scheme — this is the state Department of Agriculture's own site, useful as an authoritative directory for current district-level schemes, disaster relief input-subsidy (Government Resolution based, issued after specific calamities), and contact details for local Krishi Vibhag officers.

required_documents: Varies by specific scheme/GR — check current notifications
schemes.application_process: Contact the local Krishi Vibhag office (Taluka/District Agriculture Officer) or check the department website for current Government Resolutions (GRs) relevant to your district and situation (e.g. post-calamity input subsidy).

schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra Disaster/Calamity Input Subsidy (crop loss relief)
schemes.category: Post-calamity input subsidy for significant crop damage

conditions.notes: Maharashtra periodically issues Government Resolutions (GRs) providing input subsidy to farmers after natural calamities (unseasonal rain, pest outbreaks, etc.) when crop loss crosses a threshold - historically around 33% loss, following national SDRF/NDRF norms, though the exact threshold and rate vary by GR. This is only genuinely relevant if your damage is significant.

required_documents: Panchnama (crop damage survey/assessment) done by local revenue/agriculture officials
schemes.application_process: Crop damage is typically assessed via a village-level Panchnama survey conducted by the Talathi/Agriculture Assistant after a calamity is reported. Contact your local Krishi Vibhag or Talathi office to request a survey if you haven't already had one done. Payment follows the specific GR issued for that calamity/season.

schemes.scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme
schemes.description: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest (4% effective with government subsidy). Flexible repayment aligned with harvest.

conditions.notes: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest (4% effective with government subsidy). Flexible repayment aligned with harvest.

schemes.application_process: Apply at any bank branch, Regional Rural Bank, or cooperative bank with land records.

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
schemes.description: 'More Crop Per Drop' — subsidies on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. Covers up to 55% (small/marginal) or 45% (others) of cost.

conditions.notes: 'More Crop Per Drop' — subsidies on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. Covers up to 55% (small/marginal) or 45% (others) of cost.

schemes.application_process: Apply through state agriculture department or district horticulture office. Check DBT portal.

schemes.scheme_name: National Agriculture Market
schemes.description: Online trading platform enabling farmers to sell crops to buyers across India, getting better prices through transparent auction.

conditions.notes: Online trading platform enabling farmers to sell crops to buyers across India, getting better prices through transparent auction.

schemes.application_process: Register at enam.gov.in or at your nearest APMC mandi.

schemes.scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: ₹50,000/hectare support for adopting organic farming through cluster approach. Includes certification and market linkage support.

conditions.notes: ₹50,000/hectare support for adopting organic farming through cluster approach. Includes certification and market linkage support.

schemes.application_process: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or district agriculture office for cluster formation.

schemes.scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
schemes.description: Subsidy up to 50% on tractors, harvesters, and farm equipment. Registered on DBT Agriculture portal.

conditions.notes: Subsidy up to 50% on tractors, harvesters, and farm equipment. Registered on DBT Agriculture portal.

schemes.application_process: Register on DBT Agriculture portal and apply through district agriculture office.

schemes.scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.description: Strengthens agriculture and allied sector infrastructure. Funds for storage, processing units, and agri-entrepreneurship.

conditions.notes: Strengthens agriculture and allied sector infrastructure. Funds for storage, processing units, and agri-entrepreneurship.

schemes.application_process: Apply through State Agriculture Department. States prepare project proposals for central approval.

schemes.scheme_name: MahaDBT Farmer Schemes Portal
schemes.description: Umbrella portal for Maharashtra state agricultural schemes including seed subsidy, equipment grants, and irrigation support.

conditions.notes: Umbrella portal for Maharashtra state agricultural schemes including seed subsidy, equipment grants, and irrigation support.

schemes.application_process: Register on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in. Schemes open/close seasonally — check current open schemes.

schemes.scheme_name: Namo Shetkari Maha Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Maharashtra's own farmer support scheme giving ₹6,000/year on top of PM-KISAN's ₹6,000, effectively ₹12,000/year total.

conditions.notes: Maharashtra's own farmer support scheme giving ₹6,000/year on top of PM-KISAN's ₹6,000, effectively ₹12,000/year total.

schemes.application_process: Auto-enrolled if registered for PM-KISAN. Verify at mahaagri.gov.in.

schemes.scheme_name: Maharashtra Calamity Input Subsidy (post-disaster)
schemes.description: Input subsidy after natural calamities when crop loss exceeds ~33%, following SDRF/NDRF norms. Issued via Government Resolution.

conditions.notes: Input subsidy after natural calamities when crop loss exceeds ~33%, following SDRF/NDRF norms. Issued via Government Resolution.

schemes.application_process: Request Panchnama from local Talathi/Agriculture Assistant. Payment follows GR for that calamity.

schemes.application_process: Apply at district agriculture office or nearest bank branch.

schemes.scheme_name: Punjab Minimum Support Price Procurement

conditions.notes: Paddy and wheat procurement at MSP through PUNGRAIN and FCI. Ensures farmers get guaranteed minimum prices.

schemes.application_process: Register at nearest government procurement center (mandi) before harvest season.

schemes.scheme_name: Haryana Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana

schemes.application_process: Register on fasal.haryana.gov.in or at nearest CSC/Jandhan center.

conditions.notes: UP state support for distressed farmers including compensation for crop damage and advisory services.

schemes.application_process: Contact Zila Krishi Adhikari (District Agriculture Officer) in your district.

schemes.application_process: Apply on upagriculture.com or through block agriculture office.

schemes.description: AP's farmer investment support giving ₹13,500/year (on top of PM-KISAN). One of the highest state-level income supports in India.
